newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen following Wall Street down.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen following Wall Street down.

text.p: Danish share prices were expected on Tuesday to ape Wall Street's overnight plunge and local dealers expected a fall of up to two percent during the course of the day.
"Its a signal for profit-taking that many have been waiting for so the KFX index could well fall one or two percent," a dealer said.
The index closed on Monday at a record 173.11, but in thin trade at the start of the Danish summer holiday season. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
